entries.test: Public reporting on Google's search strategy and its co-founders' return could establish whether obscuring search's purpose prompted their involvement in competing with ChatGPT.
entries.note: “Degraded its search engine” broadens the specific assertion that Google “obfuscated the purpose” of search. The causal connection requires evidence beyond the co-founders' return alone.

entries.test: Contemporaneous staffing reports, Microsoft investment announcements and financial reporting, and Microsoft's layoff announcement would establish OpenAI's headcount, the investment amount, and its timing relative to the 10,000 layoffs.
entries.note: Microsoft is the identifiable competitor referenced in context; “just” is relative to the February 2023 publication date.
